claims.content: High melting points cause refractory HEA processing problems.
claims.evidence_span: However, the high melting point of refractory HEAs leads to processing problems when using traditional processing techniques.

claims.content: Uniform mixing remains difficult in refractory HEAs.
claims.evidence_span: the full mixing of elements in the refractory HEAs is still a challenge

claims.content: Low ductility and high strength impede processing.
claims.evidence_span: The low ductility at room temperature and high strength of refractory HEAs render them very difficult to process

claims.content: Arc melting reaches refractory temperatures but cannot form arbitrary shapes.
claims.evidence_span: although the arc melting can go up to the melting point, this method cannot form an arbitrary shape

claims.content: Rapid solidification limits grain growth time.
claims.evidence_span: when the grain nuclei formed, their growth-driving force was large but the growth-time was limited

claims.content: SLM reduced mean grain size to 13.4 micrometers.
claims.evidence_span: The average grain size is 13.4 μm, which is much smaller compared with the 200 μm of as-cast NbMoTaW HEA grain size

claims.content: Smaller BCC grains improve several mechanical properties.
claims.evidence_span: Therefore, the plasticity, fatigue strength, and creep rate of the polycrystal BCC metal are improved when the grain size decreases

claims.content: The measured composition deviation stays within HEA ranges.
claims.evidence_span: Although there is a maximal 3.5% composition deviation, as a HEA, the constituent range from 5–35% is acceptable

claims.content: Earlier laser cladding produced a refractory TiZrNbWMo HEA coating.
claims.evidence_span: Zhang et al. [ [14] ] synthesized a refractory HEA coating with composition close to TiZrNbWMo on C45 steel by laser cladding.

claims.content: As-cast NbMoTaW has only 0.2% plastic strain.
claims.evidence_span: the as-cast NbMoTaW HEA is brittle with plastic strain ɛ p = 0.2%

claims.content: SLM's brief intense heating and rapid cooling should favor HEA solid solutions.
claims.evidence_span: the SLM process has very high cooling rates, which benefits the formation of solid solutions in HEAs

claims.content: Low-density, low-melting constituents preferentially evaporate from the laser-heated surface.
claims.evidence_span: these elements with lower melting points arrive at the boiling point earlier and evaporate more during the SLM process

claims.content: Hall-Petch grain refinement links SLM microstructure to improved mechanical properties.
claims.evidence_span: The well-known Hall–Petch (HP) law [ [22] , [23] ] illustrates the dependence of the grain size with the macroscopic plastic and the relationship between the brittle fracture stresses and polycrystal structure.
the average microhardness value of the NbMoTaW HEA s (sintering by SLM) sample is 826 Hv

claims.content: Passivating Nb, Mo, and Ta support corrosion resistance in salt solution.
claims.evidence_span: the elements Nb, Mo, and Ta contained in the alloy are all the easy passivation metals, which contributes to the excellent corrosion resistance in the 3.5 %wt NaCl solution

claims.content: Corrosion current is two orders of magnitude below 316L steel.
claims.evidence_span: the free-corrosion current of the HEA is reduced by two orders of magnitude compared with that of the 316 L steel
